conviction_note: Pre-revenue name whose print turns on narrative (Eagle Line output, sample shipments, new-vertical announcements, billings, cash). The one document-backed lean is negative: the July 2026 PowerCo amendment caps the program at $75.4M including amounts already paid and moves payments to milestones, so Q3 billings are likely well below Q2's $10.8M. Against that sit a short base of 18.1% of float at 9.1 days to cover, call skew of -9.9 vol points and a stock at its 52-week low. abs_move is the 10% option-implied move, which sits above the 7.0% median reaction and below the 12-13% of two of the last four prints. p_up is 48, close to a coin, so expected_move is -0.4. That is about equal to the finding sum of -0.2: the two measurements agree that there is no strong lean.

findings.finding: The 8-K filed 2026-07-22 (Items 1.01/1.02) amends the PowerCo program. The maximum aggregate PowerCo will pay is $75.4M 'inclusive of amounts paid to date' (it was up to $131M), cost-reimbursement SOW No.1 was terminated on 2026-07-16, and further payments depend on milestones (cell delivery and validation over the next two years). Q2 customer billings were $10.8M, of which $10.4M was PowerCo collaboration cash. Billings were roughly $41M from 2025 through H1 2026, so the remaining program headroom is about $34M or less over two years, about $4M a quarter. Q3 billings are therefore likely to fall well below Q2's $10.8M unless a milestone landed in the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Billings were introduced as a headline metric in 2025-2026; on Q2 (2026-07-22) the company touted H1 billings beating all of FY2025 and the stock still fell 12.86% on the PowerCo cut and cash burn. Q4 2025 (2026-02-11) fell 11.96% on 2026 loss expectations.
findings.why_not_priced: No aggregator carries a billings estimate (the revenue rows are blank or a stray $29M), and the 'amounts paid to date' arithmetic is not in any preview found. If the market had priced a step-down, sell-side previews would carry a billings line and the skew would not be bid to the upside. Some of it is surely priced: the cut was public in July and the stock fell 13% on it.
findings.independence: Q2 letter: billings $10.8M and PowerCo collaboration cash $10.4M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001811414/000119312526312423/qs-ex99_1.htm). The Q4 2025 letter says billings 'may vary from quarter to quarter' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1811414/000119312526046623/qs-ex99_1.htm). These are the same company's documents, not an independent series. Invoices issued before July 'remain due', which supports cash received but not new billings.

findings.finding: The Q2 2026 shareholder letter sets the H2 bar the Q3 letter will be graded on: 'further double cell output in the second half of 2026' on the Eagle Line (core tools above 90% uptime), and 'customer sample shipments accelerating significantly across all three verticals' (QSEV, QSDC data centers, QSAS defense). On the Q2 call the CEO said for QSDC that 'announcements are coming with timelines attached'. Since 2026-07-22 there has been no 8-K or press release beyond the Oct 8 timing notice, so any named data-center/ODM partner or defense customer would be new tonight.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Partnership news has not paid on print night. Q2 (Honda deal plus Eagle Line progress plus an EPS beat) went -12.86%. Q3 2025 (2025-10-22) went +7.95% on Eagle Line/Cobra progress, the one large up reaction tied to operational milestones.
findings.why_not_priced: Little is priced. The stock is at 52-week lows with 7 holds and 2 sells, and whether the QSDC 'announcements with timelines' arrive tonight is unknown to anyone. If the market expected a named customer, the stock would not be at its low; the call-side skew does show some optionality is being paid for.
findings.independence: Call commentary 'announcements are coming with timelines attached' per the TopSecretStocks call summary (https://topsecretstocks.substack.com/p/quantumscape-q2-2026-update, 2026-07-23). findings.finding: The arithmetic of the company's own guide points to an in-line-to-better loss. FY2026 adjusted EBITDA loss guidance is $250-275M (reiterated 2026-07-22) against H1 of $127.5M, which implies Q3 at about $61-74M versus Q2's $64.2M. Capex guidance was cut to $27-37M against $14.6M spent in H1. Q2 GAAP EPS was -$0.16, so the -$0.17/-$0.18 consensus looks conservative; a narrowing toward the low end of the EBITDA guide is plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EPS beats are sold: Q2 2026 beat (-$0.16 vs -$0.18) and fell 12.86%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced: the guide is public and the company reaffirms it routinely. The only unpriced part is whether the range narrows, which would be a small cash-burn positive on a name that sold off on burn in July.
findings.independence: Consensus spread: Earnings Whispers -$0.18 (https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/qs), Benzinga -$0.17 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/QS/earnings-forecasts). This shares the Q2 letter with findings 1 and 2, but it rests on a different line (opex, not billings or milestones).

findings.finding: Positioning into the print: short interest is 112.2M shares, 18.1% of float, 9.1 days to cover, up 14.7% month over month. The 25d skew is -9.87 vol points (calls over puts), put/call OI is 0.32, and the stock is $4.045, -17.6% over 20 days and 3.85% above its 52-week low. A short that has been building into the low turns any non-negative surprise into a covering mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 at +7.95% and Q4 2024 (2025-02-12) at +7.04% were the up reactions. The two most recent large moves were both down (-12.86% and -11.96%), so shorts have been paid on recent prints.
findings.why_not_priced: The option market partly prices it, through the call skew and a 10% implied move. What is not priced is the asymmetry: 9 days to cover on a stock at its lows. If covering were complete, short interest would be falling, not up 14.7% m/m.
findings.independence: Benzinga short float 20.2-20.7% in August 2026 (https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/QS/short-interest). The skew comes from the sealed baseline (Yahoo chain).

findings.finding: PowerCo's royalty prepayment ($130M) and IP license remain gated on technical milestones and 'form-factor alignment', with no dates. VW's CFO has cut the PowerCo budget from €15bn to 'significantly below €10bn', and Salzgitter's ramp to 40 GWh is on hold. Any timing slip on the license or prepayment disclosed tonight would land on the market's largest open question.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The PowerCo scope cut disclosed with Q2 (2026-07-22) was cited as the main reason for the -12.86% reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the budget cut dates from December 2025 and the program cut from July 2026. The residual is whether the Q3 letter restates the 2029 SOP and the prepayment conditions or softens them. This is a proxy, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Q2 call per MarketBeat: the $130M prepayment is unchanged and 2029 SOP has not been changed (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/quantumscape-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-07-22/). That source cuts against a slip, so the size is small.

findings.why_not_priced: The runway is visible, multi-year at roughly $60M a quarter, so there is no distress. The sign depends on whether the company taps equity at the lows; nothing filed says it will. What the money would buy is the Eagle Line ramp, which is already funded. So the sign is mildly negative and the size small.

baseline_tension: The skew pays for upside and a crowded, growing short sits at the 52-week low. My one document-backed lean (lower billings) is negative, so it cuts against the skew and the positioning; that is why the negatives are small and p_up sits at 48 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (crowded short, call skew against the sign): shrank the negatives. Billings -1.0 to -0.7, PowerCo/VW -0.3 to -0.2, liquidity/ATM -0.3 to -0.2, insider sales -0.2 to -0.1.
Rule 1 (beats sold; the Q2 EPS beat plus Honda news went -12.9%): shrank the reported-quarter positives. H2 commitments +0.5 to +0.3, EBITDA/EPS arithmetic +0.3 to +0.2.
Core step 4 / Rule 7 (the squeeze mechanism is already applied by shrinking the negatives): cut the standalone positioning finding from +1.0 to +0.5 so the crowded short is not counted twice.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): kept the ATM/liquidity item small and noted that the money would fund an already-funded Eagle Line ramp, with no ATM filed.
